programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2757粵
programme.desc: 力蓮款待若水等人聚餐，並安排抽獎。樹仁抽獲一個監控鏡頭，並置於熊家廳中。眾人透過手機軟件能即時監察或翻看廳中的情形，驗證鏡頭的實際功用後，同意軟件提出的永久使用條款。其後，鏡頭的全面功能更獲得解鎖，城安竟利用監控片段要脅熊家眾人，藉此取得不少好處。眾人因監控鏡頭而爭執不斷，本來打算將它拆除，卻未能成功。鑑於眾人難以戒除經常偷看監控影像的習慣，尚善提出一個出乎意料的解決方法……

programme.title: X Wallet呈獻:臥底嬌娃#9粵PG
programme.desc: 佳琪懷疑奕風持有粉精靈配方，想跟蹤奕風，被妙姿制止。妙姿指配方是自己偽造，但佳琪仍懷疑奕風。小茹順利在洗衣店工作，查悉前老闆跟四聯商會有關，後來轉手予愛邦妮集團。妙姿這才知悉嘉盈死前在愛邦妮工作，更覺她的死有可疑。妙姿怕會被調出臥底小組，求小茹將嘉盈之事保密。小茹與貌似漫畫角色的男子結緣，卻不知對方就是索帕。醉漢在洗衣店搗亂，前來幫助的警員，竟是除夕時親吻小茹的歐凱，小茹對歐凱認不出自己而失落。

programme.title: 機智女法醫2#1粵普PG
programme.desc: 從小仰慕玉面判官的楚楚成為三法司仵作，與蕭瑾瑜成了夫妻，又結識了朋友景翊和冷月，一起攜手破獲大案。一轉眼，三年已過。他們進宮參加壽昌節宴，怎料在宴會期間，池子裡突然有一個頭顱跳起來，眾人驚慌失措…

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：攻你上大學粵
programme.desc: 《璀璨之城》考場角力延續，有三位「精英學生」距離升讀大學僅一題之遙。新鮮菠蘿醃牛扒是烹飪祕訣，熱愛下廚者輕鬆秒答！大學一年級中醫學穴位題，曾有相關演出經驗可會幫到手？關於人工智能、「繁殖正義」、香港舊式公屋的考題，同樣出現「供他人升班」狀況，受惠者不忘「禮貌」稱謝。來到一對一交鋒，「優異生」將答題機會握在自己手裡，「金融動物」決定命運？終極大四題涉及對行星的知識，「畢業生」憑直覺挑戰贏「獎學金」！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#17粵
programme.desc: 少龍以通訊器內藏的抗生素救趙倩，琴清知道少龍喜歡自己，但見他與趙倩情深義重，拒愛。李斯借糧成功向眾人辭行，願幫忙送少龍與趙倩出魏境。二人藏身運糧馬車的夾層內，中途給魏牟發現，少龍為免連累斯，帶趙倩騎馬離開，中箭抱趙倩跳崖。二人來到石頭村，令滕、荊兩家招致殺身之禍。滕翼與荊俊悲痛欲絕。少龍引魏牟回來讓滕翼親手殺他，並與二人結拜。趙穆以趙盤性命要脅趙雅交出祕錄。趙雅翌日以祕錄交換趙盤，母子急忙離開。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 若晚上頻繁出現抽筋，中醫師提到或跟肝血不足、脾胃虛弱、腎氣不足等相關。醫師對應不同的證型提供保健湯水，並介紹穴位按壓之法，同時提醒觀眾可從日常生活習慣中着手改善情況。跑步後如膝蓋內側出現不適甚至疼痛，可能是患上「鵝掌肌腱炎」，甚麼人士屬高危一族？運動治療師帶來此症的治療與改善資訊，又引領主持一同示範鍛練運動，有助舒緩這炎症。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨師傅炮製「XO楓樹糖漿脆脆雞」，香甜滋味。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在廣州粵
programme.desc: 廣州，粵菜發源地之一，廣府菜的中心，是每一位食客都無法拒絕的美食聖地。愛喫愛玩的主持人麥包，在廣州徹底釋放了喫貨天性，走遍大街小巷，尋找地道美食：悠閑早茶、西關小喫、新潮佳饌，夜市小攤

programme.title: 單戀雙城#21粵
programme.desc: 追求展禛的Simon來了香港，展禛扮成壞女孩把對方嚇走，錢進偷拍後用片段要脅展禛。式適向恭梓哭訴已無法無條件相信展博，展博向式適坦白恭梓對自己的協助，式適責怪恭梓。以蕎把恭梓所唱的錄音碟交給式適。

programme.title: 香港本色粵
programme.desc: 金雕、玉雕、牙雕已成夕陽行業，一班手藝非凡的老師傅，如何為這些傳統工藝「守尾門」？一塊金磚，由熔金到打磨，每個步驟都要一絲不苟，打金師傅胡文楷卻稱學習了「批、鑲、卓、鑿」已稱得上滿師，但要怎樣才能獨當一面？經過師傅悉心設計，一塊石頭，隨時會變成價值連成的寶玉！何以香蕉、燒肉、龍蝦等亦能成為精緻的玉器擺設？牙雕業在國際實施象牙禁運後面臨重大衝擊，何以朱忠盛仍堅持守護這門即將絕跡的手藝？

programme.title: 天龍八部#20粵普PG
programme.desc: 虛竹得段延慶指點破解棋局，卻被意外捲進山洞。他在洞裡見到無崖子，無崖子將其七十年功力傳授給他，臨終前更命他繼任逍遙派掌門之位。眾人中了丁春秋之毒，虛竹用蘇星河教授之法為眾人療傷，玄難大師卻毒發身亡。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 下白泥是野餐好地點，今集遊戲全部與食物有關。首次參與遊戲的蝦頭，飢餓得要用「泰山壓頂」招數來喫懸在對手頭上的食物，哪位男藝員被寵幸？舉手可招來侍應，舉腳纔可進食是甚麼玩法？藝員出醜食相盡呈現！野餐不能缺少三文治，再加上綠色醬料，一場wasabi災難又上演……Bob發揮「神預測」本色，換來全部人員最期待的大懲罰！遊戲盡顯特玩隊的人性醜惡，但天意卻讓他們出線爭獎品，「輸家」連詩雅竟有出頭天！

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S2
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的巖漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S2
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的巖漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 【完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款!尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛?】講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值。原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中。《夏娃的醜聞》裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天、《邪門》徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦。此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與樸海鎮領銜，知名主角羣展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神祕性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 韓國小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 【完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款!尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛?】講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值。原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中。《夏娃的醜聞》裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天、《邪門》徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦。此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數。

programme.title: 韓國小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師樸海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神祕又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這羣「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.title: 淘氣鼠兄弟S3

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S2
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的巖漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S2
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的巖漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.desc: 【完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款!尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛?】講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值。原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中。《夏娃的醜聞》裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天、《邪門》徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦。此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與樸海鎮領銜，知名主角羣展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神祕性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 韓國小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師樸海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神祕又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這羣「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.desc: Lúcia is raped by her husband and presses charges against him. In her quest for justice, she must battle her husband who is the son of the State's Vice Attorney, and the Portuguese legal system with its patriarchal beliefs.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Sticky Gecko
programme.desc: Mum must get Bluey and Bingo out the door in time for a playdate, but they can't leave before they finish their game - waiting for a sticky rubber gecko to drop from the ceiling.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Faceytalk
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin won't give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures (S1) - Andy and the Bobwhite Quails
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head off on a global adventure to North America to discover the creatures living in the wild spaces between crops. Along the way, they meet some bobwhite quails.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Ball
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun playing with their favourite red bouncy ball. It drops into the Ice Disco, giving Hettie the Yeti an idea for a bouncy dance!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Commuting Badge
programme.desc: Norrie is running late to Squirrel Club, so Duggee teaches the squirrels what a commute is - a journey that can take you from home to learn, work or play.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Wisdom Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee reading about wise animals and wish to learn more about what it means to be wise.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Listening Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels hear a strange sound that they've not heard before, so they ask Duggee to help identify it.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Bioluminescent Bay, Puerto Rico
programme.desc: Glitch's bath time puts the creatures of Puerto Rico's Bioluminescent Bay in bubble-trouble.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Gobi Desert, Mongolia
programme.desc: Glitch's giant drill causes a dino-disaster for the team's fossil hunt in the Gobi Desert.

programme.title: Thomas &amp; Friends (S24) - Thomas and the Forest Engines
programme.desc: In Brazil, Thomas meets two wood-burning engines who've never travelled beyond their eucalyptus railway.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Arcade Dance Off
programme.desc: Stumbling across an arcade, Sarah takes on a dancing challenge with John, whilst Duck and Flamingo team up to try and defeat a video game!

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Donkey Jump
programme.desc: Sarah &amp;amp; Duck try to help Donkey get his jumping confidence back by building a surprise for him in their back garden.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Treat
programme.desc: Stanley's friends throw him a birthday party. No work for Stan today. Cynthia and Jose take a call from Amare, her tractor is stuck in the mud. Soon, so are all Stanley's vehicles.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Detective
programme.desc: Myrtle calls Stanley to help solve the mystery of the Phantom Knitter. Overhearing this, Fifi jumps at the chance to help forming a dynamic, detective duo!

programme.title: Number 1 Newton Avenue (S1) - Mum's Moves
programme.desc: Libby has made bracelets for her teddies. Mum is impressed and asks if she can have one too. Libby gets to work while Mum has a dance to some pop music.

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time to Build a Nest
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran spot a bird's nest in Cynthia's garden, which inspires JoJo to make a nest for Panda. Meanwhile, Daddy helps teach JoJo how to whistle just like a bird.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Dancing Bug Badge
programme.desc: When a dancing bug lands on Duggee's head, he can't stop dancing. The Squirrels see that it's a tiny hillbilly bug with a fiddle. And what's more, he's got a band with him - the Hillbilly Bug Band.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Teamwork Badge
programme.desc: A box full of bits and pieces is delivered to the Clubhouse and the Squirrels are excited. Duggee and the Squirrels are going to have to work hard to put it all together. Time for a bit of teamwork.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - What's Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&amp;amp;E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Nomads, Mongolia
programme.desc: Glitch offends some nomads in Mongolia, so it's down to the Go Jetters to take the reins.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits (S1) - Strawberry
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp;amp; Fruits Theatre, it's Strawberry, who used to be insecure, but now can't wait to celebrate herself and sing her song, See the Seeds!

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits (S1) - Runner Beans
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp;amp; Fruits Theatre, it's the speedy dancing runner beans!

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Spooky Day
programme.desc: Supertato runs in fright when Pumpkin tries to make friends with him, but later realises she needs his help as she's stuck in the air hanging from balloons set up by Evil Pea.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Pea's Power Suit
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of Supertato, the world's first potato superhero as he tackles the mischievous Evil Pea, in the supermarket aisles.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Crazy Golf
programme.desc: Laa-Laa shows Tinky Winky how to play crazy golf. Tinky Winky loves hitting the ball which travels up and down the hills of Teletubbyland and in to the Tiddlytubbies.

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S2) - Bath
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'bath' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure! We see lots of different baths - a baby bath, a bubble bath, a bird bath and even a banana bath!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S3) - Weather Balloons
programme.desc: Zim's weather balloons have gone missing and Mayor Oki's weather forecasts are completely wrong. Messy, Zoom and Zim must fly through the skies to track the balloons down.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Big Top Bo
programme.desc: Tao can't go on with his circus performance, so there are going to be some disappointed fans, unless Bo agrees to do all the acts for him - with some help from Mojo's tops!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.desc: Norrie is running late to Squirrel Club, so Duggee teaches the squirrels what a commute is - a journey that can take you from home to learn, work or play.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Wisdom Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee reading about wise animals and wish to learn more about what it means to be wise.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Listening Badge

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Bioluminescent Bay, Puerto Rico
programme.desc: Glitch's bath time puts the creatures of Puerto Rico's Bioluminescent Bay in bubble-trouble.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Gobi Desert, Mongolia
programme.desc: Glitch's giant drill causes a dino-disaster for the team's fossil hunt in the Gobi Desert.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - Thomas and the Forest Engines
programme.desc: In Brazil, Thomas meets two wood-burning engines who've never travelled beyond their eucalyptus railway.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Arcade Dance Off
programme.desc: Stumbling across an arcade, Sarah takes on a dancing challenge with John, whilst Duck and Flamingo team up to try and defeat a video game!

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Donkey Jump
programme.desc: Sarah &amp; Duck try to help Donkey get his jumping confidence back by building a surprise for him in their back garden.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Treat
programme.desc: Stanley's friends throw him a birthday party. No work for Stan today. Cynthia and Jose take a call from Amare, her tractor is stuck in the mud. Soon, so are all Stanley's vehicles.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Detective
programme.desc: Myrtle calls Stanley to help solve the mystery of the Phantom Knitter. Overhearing this, Fifi jumps at the chance to help forming a dynamic, detective duo!

programme.title: Number 1 Newton Avenue (S1) - Mum's Moves
programme.desc: Libby has made bracelets for her teddies. Mum is impressed and asks if she can have one too. Libby gets to work while Mum has a dance to some pop music.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time to Build a Nest
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran spot a bird's nest in Cynthia's garden, which inspires JoJo to make a nest for Panda. Meanwhile, Daddy helps teach JoJo how to whistle just like a bird.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Dancing Bug Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Teamwork Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - What's Hot?

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Nomads, Mongolia

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Runner Beans

programme.title: Number 1 Newton Avenue (S1) - Once Upon a Pond
programme.desc: Freddie is making a small pond from a washing up bowl in Aunt Fee's garden She asks Freddie to fill it with a bucket, while she gets a surprise for the pond.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - Mother's Day
programme.desc: Four generations of JoJo's family - JoJo, Mummy, Gran Gran and Great-Gran-Gran - have a relaxing spa day together as they celebrate Mother's Day!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Train Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is playing with his train set. Choo-choo! It's amazing! The squirrels are curious and want to know all about it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Dancing Bug Badge
programme.desc: When a dancing bug lands on Duggee's head, he can't stop dancing. The Squirrels see that it's a tiny hillbilly bug with a fiddle. And what's more, he's got a band with him - the Hillbilly Bug Band.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - I'm Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Go Jet Academy: Compass Navigators
programme.desc: Can Kyan and Foz use new compass skills to navigate their way out of an academy maze?

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Potato
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits theatre, it's Potato dedicating a song to his uncle Spud, who went on a spaceship to the moon.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Strawberry
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits Theatre, it's Strawberry, who used to be insecure, but now can't wait to celebrate herself and sing her song, See the Seeds!

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Pea's Power Suit
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of Supertato, the world's first potato superhero as he tackles the mischievous Evil Pea, in the supermarket aisles.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Double Doughnut Rescue
programme.desc: Evil Pea plunges Broccoli and Carrot into the doughnut toppings simultaneously and Supertato almost quits being a Superhero when he can't save his two friends at the same time.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Where? There!
programme.desc: Laa-Laa and Po play a game of 'hide and seek'. They both take turns at hiding. Tinky Winky and Dispsy are hiding too and Laa-Laa and Po find them together.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become "The Five Shaolin Masters".

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: The Bloody Escape
programme.desc: Ku is a skilled Kung Fu artist brought up by the bandits and does not agree with the brutal leader of the bandit's camp. He rescues Tong, a young lady forced to become the leader's wife, causing both the authorities and bandits to come after them. Ku has to stand up against the bandits that he grew up with so as to start a new life for himself.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score "The Proud One". Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lin's sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: Duel Of Fist
programme.desc: Fan Ke discovers at his father's deathbed that he has a half-brother, Wenlie, in Thailand. He goes to find Wenlie, who became a boxer to support his sick mother. Following their encounter, the two got involved in the underworld of boxing match gambling.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiao's Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: The Golden Buddha
programme.desc: A map indicating the location of the Chan's family heirloom is hidden in three Golden Buddha statues. Paul, an insurance agent, finds one statue by chance and Chan's daughter has another one. This makes them targets of treasure-hunting criminals and they have to team up to defeat them before unveiling the hidden secrets.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: This is Jenny Hu's stunning debut as a struggling singer who tries to keep her career and marriage intact. This movie also includes seven memorable hit songs.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and has to team up with his partner to recover the munitions so as to prevent a disaster from occurring.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng's friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident...

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle...

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm's VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor's eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor's eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter -the sole witness- mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder happens, and the suspects get killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy over two generations.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.desc: The Librarians head to Paris after a string of robberies leaves mysteriously lovestruck victims in their wake. When they learn that a magical love artefact is behind the thefts, they enlist help from Vikram's old friend -- Cupid himself.

programme.title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter - And The Memory Crystal
programme.desc: The team goes to a college campus with a world-class observatory to discover who is using the Crystal of Dr. John Dee to steal people's memories, in order to own the future.

programme.title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter - And The House Of Cards
programme.desc: When the magic door reroutes Charlie, Lysa and Connor to a bizarre manor where a series of Agatha Christie-style murders take place, they must figure out whodunit, while Vikram tries to track them down with the help of a mysterious tarot card reader.

programme.title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter - And The Con-Con
programme.desc: Connor is forced to reconnect with people from his pre-Library life, and must defeat an old adversary who has grown powerful in his absence.

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP37
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: Brick Slaves - EP7
programme.desc: LAU YIU-MING (Vincent Wong) exhausts the money that he and his girlfriend have saved for many years to buy a property and is about to get married. Out of the blue, his girlfriend not only wants to break up with him, but also secretly leases the premises out to a piano teacher, CHOI KIN-CHING (Selena Li). Unfortunately, YIU-MING's bad day gets even worse as he is soon laid off from work.

programme.title: The Runner - EP17
programme.desc: Web media editor Ho Ka-yan (Elaine Yiu) encounters track and field coach Yuen Nik (Joel Chan) as she is assigned the task of approaching the Windchasers Club and digging up scandalous dirt. Because of some past regrettable incident, Yuen Nik avoids socializing with other people. But he is getting closer and closer to Ka-yan as he repeatedly mingles with her. Kwok Bui-yee (Tiffany Lau), daughter of tycoon Kwok Wong-po (Ram Chiang), eagerly joins Windchasers as she has some ulterior motive.

programme.title: Rosy Business - EP3
programme.desc: HONG PO KEI’s (Tang Shui Man, Sheren) engagement with Wuxi rice baron TSEUNG KIU (Yueh Wah) broke off many years ago when a natural disaster hit the country. Later when the country was running out of food supply her whole family was killed and she become a criminal. Over the years, KEI has never got over KIU. She has been trying to prove he is not as heartless as the others think. Fate has it that they meet again and she becomes his fourth wife.

programme.title: Law dis-Order - EP24
programme.desc: As the founder of the leading Chinese law firm, CHEUK KAI-YIU (Lau Dan) has been re-elected as chairman of the committee for many terms. Though he promised managing partner LAU KING-CHANG (Liu Kai Chi) that he would step down, he deliberately brings in a materialistic lawyer called CHEUNG KEUNG (Alex Fong) to counterbalance KING-CHANG's obsession with power.

programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視臺定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視臺的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－鬱方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，瞭解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關喫的大哉問：喫進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，喫的順序、喫的方法與喫的健康，從不喫壞肚子到喫到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視臺定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視臺的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.desc: 在全球一片鼓勵創新創業的風潮下，臺灣未來的發展要有競爭力，即需要不斷的創新，讓年輕人有更多機會實現想法及創意，不僅是在協助青年圓夢，更是在打造國家的未來。節目中創業者分享創業甘苦談，創業時面臨的心理掙扎，以及如何克服困難，堅持理想，繼續走下去。【青年創ya家】主持人曾寶儀打破傳統一問一答的制式訪問，以如同家人、朋友間的聊天談心，讓各種你想得到的、想不到的青年創ya家，拋開緊張與包袱，輕鬆自在地分享自己的「青春進化論」。

programme.title: 紀錄曙光第1集

programme.title: 相聲百人一首第24集

programme.title: 美麗人生壯志高飛第431集
programme.desc: 臺視60週年臺慶大戲《美麗人生》第五單元《壯志高飛》，以1960年代高雄市旗津島為故事起點，三位最美麗的臺灣女人，在臺灣最美麗的年代，在最美麗的旗津，悲歡交織而成的美麗人生。數百年前，旗津還沒有一個統一的名稱，島的南端依舊與高雄相連。 而後，為了建造高雄港第二港口，旗津南端名喚『崩隙』的這片沙土挖空了，居民被迫遷移，旗津也因而斷開 了與臺灣的連繫，猶如遊子，離開了母親的懷抱。土地會消失，歷史也許會被淡忘，但曾經走過那段艱辛歲月的人們，他們的悲歡離合、笑容與淚水，仍將會轉化為孕育後代子孫的養分，開出燦爛的花朵。這是屬於我們上一代人的故事，也是我們這一代人的故事，是所有在這座島嶼上奮鬥的人們的—《

programme.desc: 360行故事多，體驗各行各業，發掘賺錢新36計。透過體驗各產業的紀錄與分享，瞭解各行各業的創業維艱，發掘其獨到之處、獨門技術，發現"不可思議"的新商機，以及驚人的經濟效益；或是體驗寓工作於娛樂，當個最樂在工作的幸福人，透過打工體驗瞭解與分享更多臺灣不為人知的感動故事。

programme.title: 同學早安第12集
programme.desc: 在家鄉玉里服務一輩子的老師「楊招治」 人生幸福組的她卻在年過半百時，失去摯愛的丈夫，面臨退休與否的抉擇。 「人生只能這樣嗎？」招治問自己。她想起家中的三老，她看見生活周遭需要幫助的靈魂，那些需要觸動了招治最溫柔的一塊心田，她知道，她的人生可以不只是這樣…

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第6集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 生活地球村第260集
programme.desc: 《生活地球村》是一個以環境、印尼當地智慧以及食物潛力為主題的紀錄片節目。本節目的製作是為了帶領觀眾意識並邀請大家在生活中實踐環保、愛護地球。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 無量義經偈頌第15集
programme.desc:
《無量義經》被譽為《法華經》的前導，也是大乘佛法中最能啟發慈悲行的經典。對證嚴上人而言，這部經是畢生體悟最深的法門，更成為慈濟法脈的根本依據。在 上人的帶領下，《無量義經》成為慈濟人行入人羣的實踐指南。
本節目以 上人講解的《無量義經》偈頌為主軸，帶領觀眾把經中智慧用在生活的每個當下，願人人能從這部經中啟發無量善念，為自己與社會帶來更多和諧與光亮。

programme.title: 大愛早安新聞 LIVE
programme.desc: 證嚴上人慈示：「新聞報導，除了『報』，還要進一步『導』，範疇要開闊，關懷普天下蒼民，為時代作見證，為人類寫歷史。」，大愛新聞透過SNG、電話連線、數位影像，傳遞全球最新訊息，堅持將人間美善訊息與人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，發揮淨化人心功能。

programme.title: 志為人醫守護愛2.0第183集
programme.desc:
什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間、在手術室、在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？
『志為人醫守護愛』帶您目擊動人的溫馨醫病情現場，透過醫療團隊的視病如親、 以病為師的堅持、病患與醫療團隊的互相感恩，體會與感受現代人醫如何幫助病患重拾信心，在他們人生低潮時重新出發，進而走入人羣，自助助人。

programme.title: 無量義經偈頌第15集
programme.desc:

programme.desc: 在家鄉玉里服務一輩子的老師「楊招治」 人生幸福組的她卻在年過半百時，失去摯愛的丈夫，面臨退休與否的抉擇。 「人生只能這樣嗎？」招治問自己。她想起家中的三老，她看見生活周遭需要幫助的靈魂，那些需要觸動了招治最溫柔的一塊心田，她知道，她的人生可以不只是這樣…

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第30集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 映照人生第492集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大。由印尼大愛臺製作的「映照人生」，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一。 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容。 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 無量義經偈頌第17集
programme.desc:
《無量義經》被譽為《法華經》的前導，也是大乘佛法中最能啟發慈悲行的經典。對證嚴上人而言，這部經是畢生體悟最深的法門，更成為慈濟法脈的根本依據。在 上人的帶領下，《無量義經》成為慈濟人行入人羣的實踐指南。
本節目以 上人講解的《無量義經》偈頌為主軸，帶領觀眾把經中智慧用在生活的每個當下，願人人能從這部經中啟發無量善念，為自己與社會帶來更多和諧與光亮。

programme.title: 仁心慧語第628集

programme.title: 大愛夜安新聞 LIVE
programme.desc: 證嚴上人慈示：「新聞報導，除了『報』，還要進一步『導』，範疇要開闊，關懷普天下蒼民，為時代作見證，為人類寫歷史。」，大愛新聞透過SNG、電話連線、數位影像，傳遞全球最新訊息，堅持將人間美善訊息與人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，發揮淨化人心功能。

programme.title: 同學早安第14集
programme.desc: 在家鄉玉里服務一輩子的老師「楊招治」 人生幸福組的她卻在年過半百時，失去摯愛的丈夫，面臨退休與否的抉擇。 「人生只能這樣嗎？」招治問自己。她想起家中的三老，她看見生活周遭需要幫助的靈魂，那些需要觸動了招治最溫柔的一塊心田，她知道，她的人生可以不只是這樣…

programme.title: 大愛醫生館第6743集
programme.desc: 不斷汲取新知，已是現代人必備的條件，對於人文精神的掌握，往往顯得貧乏。大愛醫生館藉由醫師專業知識加上俯拾即是的美感經驗與與回歸人文思想的本懷，期望幫助忙碌的現代人多關心自己與周遭人的身心健康，為醫療節目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: 看美善學美善美善劇場第545集
programme.desc: 《多謝款待》由渡邊杏主演，東出昌大、財前直見、原田泰造、木村綠子、近藤正臣等共同出演。該劇講述了主人公芽以子從大正年間直到第二次世界大戰結束的數十年間，以飽含心意的美食支持著身邊的人，並始終堅守對丈夫的愛的故事。

programme.title: 大愛真健康第908集

programme.title: 無量義經偈頌第17集
programme.desc:
《無量義經》被譽為《法華經》的前導，也是大乘佛法中最能啟發慈悲行的經典。對證嚴上人而言，這部經是畢生體悟最深的法門，更成為慈濟法脈的根本依據。在 上人的帶領下，《無量義經》成為慈濟人行入人羣的實踐指南。
本節目以 上人講解的《無量義經》偈頌為主軸，帶領觀眾把經中智慧用在生活的每個當下，願人人能從這部經中啟發無量善念，為自己與社會帶來更多和諧與光亮。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第18集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 慶餘年第15集
programme.desc: 某大學文學史專業的學生張慶（張若昀飾）熟讀古典名著，但他用現代觀念剖析古代文學史，透過寫小說的方式，進一步闡述自己想要表達的觀點。在他的小說中，身世神祕的少年範閑，自小跟隨奶奶生活在海邊小城澹州，隨著一位自稱老師的突然造訪，他看似平靜的生活開始直面重重的危機與考驗。上半部的劇情主要發生在京都，範閑追查牛欄街刺殺一案的幕後黑手。下半部劇情發生在北齊上京城，範閑親率南慶使團，前往北齊用戰犯肖恩交換言冰雲。但這只是，慶帝和陳萍萍佈局，想令肖恩誤以為範閑就是他失散多年的孫子，藉此套出神廟的祕密。

programme.title: MIT臺灣誌第624集
programme.desc: 《MIT臺灣誌》是為臺灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為臺灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT臺灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT臺灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT臺灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了臺灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自臺灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第1941集
programme.desc: 大陸尋奇是臺灣目前最社教節目之冠不惜巨資的大製作足跡踏遍各現代城市、窮鄉僻壤，深入各民族村落，記錄了外人難得一見的生活情況，以準確的地理、歷史定位，用現代化思維，把中華文化忠實的呈現。 漫遊在浩瀚中國的世外桃源，細賞湖光山色間的粉妝玉琢，帶您跋山涉水遊遍奇峯峻嶺，讓您看盡壯闊山河嘆為觀止。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子第6季:第411集
programme.desc: 本作品是以作者的童年（昭和49年，即1974年）生活為藍本的故事，其中一事一物均充滿著1970年代的懷舊氣息。故事發生的舞臺是日本靜岡縣清水市，那是一個不折不扣的美麗港都，是個交通便利、漁產豐富、又與富士山為鄰的好地方。故事圍繞著小丸子以及其家人和同學展開，有關於親情、友誼等，或是一些生活小事，但當中有笑有淚，令人回想起童年的稚氣。

programme.title: 慶餘年第17集
programme.desc: 某大學文學史專業的學生張慶（張若昀飾）熟讀古典名著，但他用現代觀念剖析古代文學史，透過寫小說的方式，進一步闡述自己想要表達的觀點。在他的小說中，身世神祕的少年範閑，自小跟隨奶奶生活在海邊小城澹州，隨著一位自稱老師的突然造訪，他看似平靜的生活開始直面重重的危機與考驗。上半部的劇情主要發生在京都，範閑追查牛欄街刺殺一案的幕後黑手。下半部劇情發生在北齊上京城，範閑親率南慶使團，前往北齊用戰犯肖恩交換言冰雲。但這只是，慶帝和陳萍萍佈局，想令肖恩誤以為範閑就是他失散多年的孫子，藉此套出神廟的祕密。

programme.title: 唱歌給你聽第64集
programme.desc: 故事講述一個在臺灣北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父親不切實際地為這個家帶來債務、困擾與紛爭。時常失蹤的父親只能由任勞任怨的母親咬牙把這個家支撐下去。多年後四處飄浪的父親癌末回來找長大後的女兒，女兒為了處理父親的臨終把本已瓦解的家庭關係，再次找回分散各地家人，並在父親臨終前相互道歉、和解道別。

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記第7集
programme.desc: 元朝末年，屠龍寶刀再現江湖，武林各派你爭我奪，激起一場腥風血雨！武當派張翠山與天鷹教殷素素因屠龍刀而相識、相戀，成親生子，也因屠龍刀而喪命，留下孤兒張無忌。張無忌少年奇遇，修煉九陽神功有成！因禍得福，習乾坤大挪移脫險！拯救明教滅教之禍，被推舉為教主！排解六大派紛爭，誓死對抗蒙古人！。同時，蒙古郡主趙敏、峨嵋派周芷若、表妹殷離、波斯少女小昭對他的傾慕，讓他不知所措，陷入情仇不分，愛中有恨的窘境………. lt;br/> lt;br/>主要演員lt;br/>曾舜晞 飾 張無忌lt;br/>陳鈺琪 飾 趙 敏lt;br/>祝緒丹 飾 周芷若lt;br/>周海媚 飾 滅絕師太lt;br/>黑 子 飾 金毛獅王 謝 遜lt;br/>許雅

programme.title: MIT臺灣誌第625集
programme.desc: 《MIT臺灣誌》是為臺灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為臺灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT臺灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT臺灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT臺灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了臺灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自臺灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第1942集
programme.desc: 大陸尋奇是臺灣目前最社教節目之冠不惜巨資的大製作足跡踏遍各現代城市、窮鄉僻壤，深入各民族村落，記錄了外人難得一見的生活情況，以準確的地理、歷史定位，用現代化思維，把中華文化忠實的呈現。 漫遊在浩瀚中國的世外桃源，細賞湖光山色間的粉妝玉琢，帶您跋山涉水遊遍奇峯峻嶺，讓您看盡壯闊山河嘆為觀止。

programme.desc: 某大學文學史專業的學生張慶（張若昀飾）熟讀古典名著，但他用現代觀念剖析古代文學史，透過寫小說的方式，進一步闡述自己想要表達的觀點。在他的小說中，身世神祕的少年範閑，自小跟隨奶奶生活在海邊小城澹州，隨著一位自稱老師的突然造訪，他看似平靜的生活開始直面重重的危機與考驗。上半部的劇情主要發生在京都，範閑追查牛欄街刺殺一案的幕後黑手。下半部劇情發生在北齊上京城，範閑親率南慶使團，前往北齊用戰犯肖恩交換言冰雲。但這只是，慶帝和陳萍萍佈局，想令肖恩誤以為範閑就是他失散多年的孫子，藉此套出神廟的祕密。

programme.title: 唱歌給你聽第45集
programme.desc: 故事講述一個在臺灣北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父親不切實際地為這個家帶來債務、困擾與紛爭。時常失蹤的父親只能由任勞任怨的母親咬牙把這個家支撐下去。多年後四處飄浪的父親癌末回來找長大後的女兒，女兒為了處理父親的臨終把本已瓦解的家庭關係，再次找回分散各地家人，並在父親臨終前相互道歉、和解道別。

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記第8集
programme.desc: 元朝末年，屠龍寶刀再現江湖，武林各派你爭我奪，激起一場腥風血雨！武當派張翠山與天鷹教殷素素因屠龍刀而相識、相戀，成親生子，也因屠龍刀而喪命，留下孤兒張無忌。張無忌少年奇遇，修煉九陽神功有成！因禍得福，習乾坤大挪移脫險！拯救明教滅教之禍，被推舉為教主！排解六大派紛爭，誓死對抗蒙古人！。同時，蒙古郡主趙敏、峨嵋派周芷若、表妹殷離、波斯少女小昭對他的傾慕，讓他不知所措，陷入情仇不分，愛中有恨的窘境………. lt;br/> lt;br/>主要演員lt;br/>曾舜晞 飾 張無忌lt;br/>陳鈺琪 飾 趙 敏lt;br/>祝緒丹 飾 周芷若lt;br/>周海媚 飾 滅絕師太lt;br/>黑 子 飾 金毛獅王 謝 遜lt;br/>許雅

programme.title: 天子傳奇第19集
programme.desc: 商朝第二十八代君－紂王，好大喜功，徵戰連連，百姓為其榷稅徵租，貧乏窮困，哀聲載道，民心漸失。一日在平魔的慶功宴時，代表大商國運的鎮國龍龜猝亡，適時西現紫氣，紂王視為必是西出妖孽，足以禍國，便遣妖帥調領大軍征剿西岐。 西伯侯姬昌第二子名曰姬發，出世時天空出現異象，百姓皆稱其為未來聖主。姬昌算易知悉姬發有九九之命格危在旦夕，便挺險施行九鼎奇法，卻因妖帥與九大護衛殺入，反成九五至尊之數。大祭司見弄巧成拙，建請紂王宣召姬發上京面聖，藉機要將姬發煉製靈人，代替護國祥物，紂王為保王命，想盡辦法不擇手段，導致天怒人怨，因此種下亡國敗運的禍根。 姬發面聖路上，災劫連連，有飄渺城之困，卻因禍得福習得「渾天寶

programme.title: 包青天第32集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.title: 土地公傳奇第7集
programme.desc: 玉帝賜封的土地公（廖峻飾），原是民間稅官，因他是凡人不會做神，玉帝就在神界選了一個既漂亮又聰明的仙女（陳亞蘭飾）做他的妻子，好協助他。這位仙女是都海城隍爺（陸一龍飾）的三女兒。土地公土地婆下界為神，土地公有求必應，為民間百姓多做善事，藉助城隍爺身邊文判官（施羽飾）、武判官（黃仲裕飾）的神界力量。

programme.title: 包青天第34集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.title: 水果冰淇淋第2797集

programme.title: 公視早安新聞第55集
programme.desc: 《公視早安新聞》（Good Morning Taiwan, PTS）是公共電視文化事業基金會新聞部製播的晨間新聞節目，於2016年6月6日開播。本節目開播時，為國英雙語節目，其中前半小時以國語播報、後半小時為以英語播報的《Good Morning Taiwan, PTS》。2017年7月31日起，公視早安新聞改為全程國語播報，而英語新聞改為週一至週五播出的《公視英語新聞》（《PTS English News》）。

programme.title: 公視手語新聞第41集
programme.desc: 公視手語新聞將轉型！擴大對聽障者的服務，將原「公視手語新聞」改版轉型為更具資訊性與生活化的新聞節目「手語資訊站」，用輕鬆方式「看見」生活新聞資訊。另將推出專為聽障朋友量身打造的單元「手語新聞通」，結合新聞小辭典以及每日一手語的特性，透過手語主播以及新聞畫面或字幕說明，正確解釋近日新聞焦點，讓聽障朋友清楚新聞脈絡，也讓觀眾學正確的手語。

programme.title: 公視越南語新聞第41集
programme.desc: 《公視越南語新聞》是一個針對越南語觀眾的新聞節目，提供最新、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題，讓觀眾在母語中深入瞭解世界各地的時事動態。

programme.title: 公視印尼語新聞第41集
programme.desc: 《公視印尼語新聞》是一個專注於印尼語觀眾的新聞節目，提供最新的印尼本土與國際新聞報導，讓觀眾獲得全球時事、文化和政治等多方面的深入瞭解與連結。

programme.title: 公視泰語新聞第41集
programme.desc: 《公視泰語新聞》是一個為泰語觀眾製作的新聞節目，提供最即時和全面的國內外新聞報導，讓觀眾深入瞭解泰國和世界各地的時事、政治、經濟、文化等重要議題。

programme.title: 黑暗中的笑臉第1集
programme.desc: 從事電影翻譯工作的魏亭對自己中規中矩、日復一日的生活感到滿意，他精準校稿、按時交件，並且無須接觸人羣，這使他安然度過混亂世界。某天，翻譯工作出了差錯，魏亭踏入二輪戲院檢視自己的作品，卻在漆黑中聽見令人心碎的笑聲，接著，女孩趙曉恭闖入他的生命，使他心慌意亂…

programme.title: 迎向邊疆公路第1集
programme.desc: 一個「家」被政府法拍，強迫搬離並準備「以車為屋」的臺灣男人，遇上一個被迫遣返回越南身上只剩下一張機票和客運費的年輕女人，兩個國籍、兩種性別，各自悵然坐在水果貨車上，指標一路向北，展開一段從臺灣南端到北端的公路旅程。只因際遇逼得人不得不有所為，命運使得他們不得不流浪……

programme.title: 樹人大冒險第1集
programme.desc: 尤瑪想去市集欣賞漂亮的首飾，但是哥哥尤命顧慮她的安危，嚴格禁止她亂跑。被限制行動的妹妹非常生氣，甚至用力咬了哥哥一口，甩開哥哥跑進了森林裡的山洞。尤瑪和尤命進入了樹人世界，而這次哥哥尤命卻被魔法命中，變成了「樹人」！憂心的妹妹只好擔起拯救哥哥的責任，踏上異世界的驚奇之旅！為了讓哥哥恢復原狀，他們必須從「鐵鋸魔」手中拯救「花精公主」；在這趟冒險的旅程，尤瑪也將深深瞭解哥哥對自己的愛。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第26集
programme.desc: 你知道臺灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道「南路鷹一萬死九千」這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味。很湊巧的，「生趣」這兩個字，其實這是客語「有趣」的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是「大自然真有趣」。這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿、旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.title: 大自然生趣第27集
programme.desc: 你知道臺灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道「南路鷹一萬死九千」這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味。很湊巧的，「生趣」這兩個字，其實這是客語「有趣」的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是「大自然真有趣」。這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿、旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.title: 理查哈蒙玩很大第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 本集理查哈蒙來到阿爾卑斯山附近的布里納山口，探索全球最長的地底隧道。理查哈蒙首先直擊重達三千公噸，全長相當於四座奧運比賽泳池的潛盾機弗菈維，瞭解其運作方式。理查隨後前往另一部潛盾機所在的探勘隧道，瞭解板塊對隧道工程的影響以及作業困難之處。參觀完緊急避難室之後，理查前往奧地利的另一處隧道施工現場，參與隧道巖面爆破工程。理查接著參觀隧道防水工程，一窺地凍工程的奧妙，回探勘隧道協助噴置混凝土。最後，理查前往瞭解隧道工程如何處理碎石廢棄物，見證人造山谷地的推動過程。

programme.desc: 理查哈蒙這次來到位於倫敦的托特納姆熱刺隊的球場。這座新體育場創造許多第一，它擁有英國最陡的觀眾席，還有西歐最大的電視螢幕，場內有歐洲最長的吧檯，甚至還有自家啤酒廠，最厲害的是可以把足球場改成美式足球場。

programme.title: 金礦的賭注-救星佛萊迪第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 佛萊迪和璜前往卑詩省幫助單獨一人採礦的泰瑞，被迫獨挑大樑，繁重的工作量讓他忙不過來。

programme.title: 翻新中古車-世界巡迴第2季:第8集
programme.desc: 麥克和艾維斯遠赴義大利，尋找一輛漂亮的飛雅特小艇雙座敞篷車。

programme.title: 金礦的賭注遠徵篇特輯第6季:第2集
programme.desc: 派克一行人的南美洲探勘之旅即將邁入尾聲，一路以來，他們遇到各種狀況和困難，深入叢林、洞穴、海拔三千公尺以上的高地，必須克服環境、地形、疾病，甚至是危險人事物的威脅。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人第19季:第12集
programme.desc: 德魯和艾爾到汎波羅拜訪歷史悠長的巡迴遊樂場表演家，滿滿的懷舊物品勾起了德魯和艾爾的兒時記憶。

programme.title: 麥克布魯爾-天生車商第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 計畫退休的麥克在太太的說服之下開了一間新車行。詹姆斯和麥克買了一輛裝了升級引擎的福斯高爾夫二代GTI，但需要稍作翻新。

programme.title: 理查哈蒙玩很大第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 理查哈蒙這次來到位於杜拜的哈里發塔，哈里發塔不但是地表最高建築物，而且還有世界最大的水舞秀。理查登上哈里發塔的最頂端，幫全球最高的避雷器換電池，還進到哈里發塔的地底世界，一窺世界最大水舞秀的祕密。同時他找到結構工程師比爾貝克，剖析如何在沙漠中讓全球最高建築穩若泰山。

programme.title: 追謎探險隊第4季:第10集
programme.desc: 喬許前往埃及，揭開古代世界中最強大女性的祕密。

programme.title: 絕地伐木勇士第2季:第7集
programme.desc: 自古以來，伐木一直是人類生活的重要產業，時至今日，仍是世界上最危險的工作之一。樹越大，風險越高...報酬也越可觀。在太平洋西北地區，伐木工傑瑞德道格拉斯帶著團隊，採伐世界上最巨大、最有價值的樹種之一：北美檜木。但要把這些體積跟巴士一樣大的巨木，從森林運送到市場一點也不容易。不僅需要高超的鋸木功夫、規模龐大的機械設備，還要有在地表最嚴酷環境上工的勇氣。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人第19季:第13集
programme.desc: 德魯和薇琪拜訪三位性質大不相同的精英古董收藏家。

programme.title: 古董商大挑戰第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 傑比和塔希比賽，尋找皮面餐桌和一套六把椅子，傑比獲勝。喬恩挑戰彤恩，替精品服飾店尋找櫥窗擺飾，喬恩挑戰成功。

programme.title: 重返核爆區
programme.desc: 1986年時，烏克蘭普利皮亞特鎮的車諾比核電廠發生史上最嚴重的核災意外。意外發生後，大量居民被迫撤離，許多人健康也受到輻射外洩影響。當局出動30萬人投入救災，其中包含醫生、科學家、軍隊，並使用了大量的機具和物資。在分秒必爭的壓力下，工程人員迅速建造出包覆核電廠的石棺，防止輻射外洩。當局並未就此掉以輕心，決定永久撤離居民並成立隔離區，嚴密監控輻射污染情形。現在隔離區內的輻射值為安全範圍之內，且有2500名人員在區內工作居住。意外發生30年後，專家長期規劃的新石棺開始運作，取代舊石棺圍堵核電廠內的輻射污染。

programme.title: 時人雜誌犯罪調查第4季:第2集
programme.desc: 羅倫森萊特原是深受歡迎的美國職籃球星，被稱為曼菲斯之子。羅倫森娶了心愛的女人，也和妻子生下六個小孩，實現他想要大家庭的夢想，但一切並不如表象那般完美。多年下來，他為了球賽不停奔波，讓家庭生活出現了裂痕，最後以離婚收場。羅倫森是好父親，離婚後仍會常常去看孩子，某天他正在陪兒子時接到神祕電話，出了門後就再也沒回家。等警方找到他時，羅倫森已經成了屍體，而且嚴重腐爛，已無法提供什麼有助調查的線索，等於一開始就成了懸案……

programme.title: 祕境廚房第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 祕境廚房逐漸擺脫疫情的陰影，開始步上正軌，艾琳和團隊回到室內空間後，就開始專心想著要做什麼樣的創新菜色。盛夏有許多特殊食材能使用，艾琳因此非常興奮，她決定改變點心盤的組合內容，用炭火烤印度烤餅，加上其他食材做出地中海風情的料理，並做一種美味的胡蘿蔔湯，主菜是夏季魚獲並用新鮮洋甘菊做桌邊沖茶服務。

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗第17季:第11集
programme.desc: 克萊菲爾婚紗店的婚紗顧問除了單純幫新娘找到夢幻之外，有時還得充當新娘最親近的閨密給予建議及支持。萬一碰到很有主見的媽媽或是意見多多、爭執不下的親友團，顧問還要適時的介入，捍衛新娘的想法及決定。有時新娘會刻意激怒媽媽，但經演老到的顧問就會知道她只是想小小叛逆一下，此時就要慢慢引導讓母女之間解除心結。

programme.title: 克莉絲汀娜鄉村家第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 在本集節目中，主持人克莉絲汀娜帶著親朋好友來到田納西州，她將幫助凱文和凱蒂把它們的義式舊房改造成現代農莊屋。由於這次的屋主有豐富的翻修經驗，所以很多地方都由他們自行施工。讓我們看看這次的團隊合作會迸出什麼樣的新火花吧。

programme.title: 我是尚娜雷第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 尚娜、奈雅與蕾莉來到繁忙的紐約市，除了要參加同志遊行外，還要為尚娜慶祝二十三歲生日。

programme.title: 邪惡枕邊人第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 表面之下，你真的瞭解與你同牀共枕的另一半嗎？事實可能出乎意料。高潮迭起的真實故事，揭開婚姻與誓言背後潛藏的黑暗面，直擊當人們遭到最親密的人背叛時，所引爆的毀滅性後果...

programme.title: 六千金在我家第5季:第11集
programme.desc: 布蕾克犬齒長歪了，夫妻倆人要帶布蕾克去拔牙；五胞胎學校辦感恩節大餐活動，丹妮爾需要在家陪五胞胎練習說出感恩之情。

programme.title: 再現失傳食譜第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 塔卡拉對已逝外曾祖母麥拉所做的猶太丸子湯念念不忘，她希望能找回這道料理的作法，除了讓來自奈及利亞的丈夫嚐嚐，也讓這份食譜回到家族中。

programme.title: 再現失傳食譜第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 本次委託的家庭是慕薩克一家，湯瑪斯廚師想還原碧雅阿嬤的招牌燉雞，調味卻總是差了一點。主持人凱西求助飲食史學家與專業廚師，為湯瑪斯找回失傳燉雞的滋味。

programme.title: 造美宅好紮根第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 本集客戶為主持人班的姐姐莎拉與她的丈夫傑森，他們的新家剛好就在班和克莉絲蒂家附近。由於是自己的家人，班在開心能協助改造住家之餘，也擔憂能不能讓他們滿意。

programme.title: 祕境廚房第2季:第6集
programme.desc: 接近盛夏時節，緬因州的藍莓季開始了，艾琳想要使用大量藍莓入菜，於是決定做一道最受餐廳員工們喜愛的油封鴨搭配藍莓和蔬菜做的沙拉。另外在甜點也加入藍莓果醬做成美味的三明治冰淇淋。由於兒時的家園要被賣掉了，本週的艾琳一直有些感傷，但在和兒時友人一起拜訪朋友已經易主的老家後讓艾琳瞭解到，雖然老家已經不在了，但那個地方仍有無限的發展性，自己也只是在家鄉展開屬於自己的全新篇章。

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗第17季:第11集
programme.desc: 克萊菲爾婚紗店的婚紗顧問除了單純幫新娘找到夢幻之外，有時還得充當新娘最親近的閨密給予建議及支持。萬一碰到很有主見的媽媽或是意見多多、爭執不下的親友團，顧問還要適時的介入，捍衛新娘的想法及決定。有時新娘會刻意激怒媽媽，但經演老到的顧問就會知道她只是想小小叛逆一下，此時就要慢慢引導讓母女之間解除心結。

programme.title: 腳痛要人命-線上看診第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 肺炎疫情肆虐全球，世界彷彿都靜止下來了，但醫學可不會停下腳步。儘管大家都待在家裡與外界隔離，但腳痛起來簡直要人命，患者更不可能得以隔離疼痛。幸好靠著線上看診，足踝外科醫師依然能與病患取得聯繫，檢查患者的足部病症。艾力克斯是腦性麻痺患者，他的肌肉運動方式與常人不同，得彎著腿走路，但這讓他的腳趾承受過大壓力，導致他有嚴重的嵌甲問題和甲失養症。儘管他平常穿了較大的鞋子，卻會讓他的腳踝沒有支撐，讓他走起路來更辛苦，莎拉豪樂醫師建議他之後得來診所一趟，檢查是否罹患關節炎，才能判斷是否該動手術。

programme.title: 腳痛要人命-線上看診第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 肺炎疫情肆虐全球，世界彷彿都靜止下來了，但醫學可不會停下腳步。儘管大家都待在家裡與外界隔離，但腳痛起來簡直要人命，患者更不可能得以隔離疼痛。幸好靠線上看診，足踝外科醫師依然能與病患取得聯繫，檢查患者的足部病症。加布利歐患有表皮溶解水皰症，除此之外，他的右腳還有蹼趾，情況變得非常棘手，就連艾波妮醫師都感到頭痛。畢竟治療蹼趾可不是一刀切開就好，還得確定有足夠的皮膚能包覆分離的腳趾。但表皮溶解水皰症讓他的皮膚非常脆弱，稍微摩擦就可能會長出水泡，在膚況不健全的情況下，他的蹼趾還有救嗎？

programme.title: 亞洲好住家第8季:第11集
programme.desc: 來自佛羅裏達州的大學教授蓋瑞與瑞貝卡夫婦因為參與海上學府計劃，深深被越南所吸引，在孩子長大之後決定放棄終身職，移居越南生活。

programme.title: 亞洲好住家第8季:第12集
programme.desc: 強接下公司在新加坡辦公室的新職位後，太太茉拉和十個月大的女兒艾拉要一起遠渡重洋搬到陌生的新加坡。

programme.title: 小鎮翻修趣振興全美第2季:第2集
programme.desc: 本集團隊拜訪了摩根堡的義消奧登和他的母親胡安妮塔，為這對致力回饋社區的母子改造房子。

programme.title: 再現失傳食譜第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 塔卡拉對已逝外曾祖母麥拉所做的猶太丸子湯念念不忘，她希望能找回這道料理的作法，除了讓來自奈及利亞的丈夫嚐嚐，也讓這份食譜回到家族中。

programme.title: 再現失傳食譜第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 本次委託的家庭是慕薩克一家，湯瑪斯廚師想還原碧雅阿嬤的招牌燉雞，調味卻總是差了一點。主持人凱西求助飲食史學家與專業廚師，為湯瑪斯找回失傳燉雞的滋味。

programme.title: 義式烹飪大賽第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 在本集節目中，12位參賽者來到義大利的普利亞，為了爭取向義式料理大師學習的機會而一較高下。

programme.title: 食材探源第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 主持人為了瞭解蜂蜜的製作過程，親自到養蜂場體驗採蜜，最後再以蜂蜜料理緬懷一位會養蜂的廚師朋友。

programme.title: 食材探源第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 本集節目中，凱蒂探索各種不同在地小農種植的米粒，親自下田採收稻米，並在節目的最後，用此行的收穫準備兩道美味料理，西班牙燉飯與米布丁。

programme.title: 裝修首購屋第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 設計師兼包商夫妻黨，善用低成本設計巧思，加上屋主自己的親力親為，協助首購族把第一個家打造成令人驚艷的理想空間，同時牢牢守住預算底線。

programme.title: 小鎮翻修趣振興全美第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 翻修團隊來到科羅拉多摩根堡，進行小鎮復興計畫。首先替一位馬場主人翻修房屋，還替一家咖啡館進行奇幻大改造。

programme.title: 明星之死第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 2014年7月2日，一名打扮有型的男子走進警局自首，坦承自己殺了妻子。警方發現這名男子竟是90年代紅極一時的男子團體成員。

programme.title: 戰痘醫師第4季:第1集
programme.desc: 蓋博的脖子上長了巨大脂肪瘤，但他對全身麻醉的恐懼使他無法下定決心前往看診，然而因生活中有諸多不便以及女友堅持，他終於向李醫師求助。

programme.title: 祕境廚房第2季:第6集
programme.desc: 接近盛夏時節，緬因州的藍莓季開始了，艾琳想要使用大量藍莓入菜，於是決定做一道最受餐廳員工們喜愛的油封鴨搭配藍莓和蔬菜做的沙拉。另外在甜點也加入藍莓果醬做成美味的三明治冰淇淋。由於兒時的家園要被賣掉了，本週的艾琳一直有些感傷，但在和兒時友人一起拜訪朋友已經易主的老家後讓艾琳瞭解到，雖然老家已經不在了，但那個地方仍有無限的發展性，自己也只是在家鄉展開屬於自己的全新篇章。

programme.title: 面子問題第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 魯斯泰安醫生與潘諾西安醫生遇上了職業生涯中最棘手的案例之一：一名擁有『兩張臉』的年輕男子。

programme.title: 我是尚娜雷第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 尚娜、奈雅與蕾莉來到繁忙的紐約市，除了要參加同志遊行外，還要為尚娜慶祝二十三歲生日。

programme.title: 六千金在我家第5季:第11集
programme.desc: 布蕾克犬齒長歪了，夫妻倆人要帶布蕾克去拔牙；五胞胎學校辦感恩節大餐活動，丹妮爾需要在家陪五胞胎練習說出感恩之情。

programme.title: 祕境廚房第2季:第7集
programme.desc: 本週的祕境廚房終於要開放三間森林小木屋做為客房，艾琳和媽媽為此事興奮不已，因為媽媽這輩子的夢想就是開一間民宿，這樣算是用另一種方式替她圓了夢，而艾琳也為住宿的旅客設計了一份簡單美味的早餐菜單，讓所有的賓客都意猶未盡。而本週除了讓人興奮的木屋啟用以外，緬因州的州長本人也將來到祕境廚房用晚餐，對艾琳來說，不管是不是州長或其他名人，所有來到祕境廚房的客人都是遠道而來的貴客。

programme.title: 義式烹飪大賽第2季:第1集

programme.title: 造美宅好紮根第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 本集客戶為主持人班的姐姐莎拉與她的丈夫傑森，他們的新家剛好就在班和克莉絲蒂家附近。由於是自己的家人，班在開心能協助改造住家之餘，也擔憂能不能讓他們滿意。

programme.title: 裝修首購屋第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 設計師兼包商夫妻黨，善用低成本設計巧思，加上屋主自己的親力親為，協助首購族把第一個家打造成令人驚艷的理想空間，同時牢牢守住預算底線。

programme.title: 克莉絲汀娜鄉村家第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 在本集節目中，主持人克莉絲汀娜帶著親朋好友來到田納西州，她將幫助凱文和凱蒂把它們的義式舊房改造成現代農莊屋。由於這次的屋主有豐富的翻修經驗，所以很多地方都由他們自行施工。讓我們看看這次的團隊合作會迸出什麼樣的新火花吧。

programme.title: 六千金在我家第5季:第11集
programme.desc: 布蕾克犬齒長歪了，夫妻倆人要帶布蕾克去拔牙；五胞胎學校辦感恩節大餐活動，丹妮爾需要在家陪五胞胎練習說出感恩之情。

programme.title: 迷你屋大夢想第8季:第8集
programme.desc: 懷抱童心的傑西和布蘭妲夫婦為兩個女兒打造了一間異想天開的航海主題迷你屋，裡面不僅有超好玩的爬行隧道可以連接孩子和爸媽的房間，屋頂還裝了一支風車為傑西所設計的迷你氣象觀測裝置供電。這對爸媽在屋內設計了非常多巧思，就連存放散裝食物的方式也十分別出心裁。

programme.title: 迷你屋大夢想第8季:第9集
programme.desc: 布莉安娜和克里斯才剛結婚不到七個月，兩人決定從繁忙的紐約市中心搬到佛蒙特，享受更貼近大自然的迷你屋生活。在大城市租了頗久的房子以後，兩人都對一起構築鄉間小屋非常期待，甚至興致勃勃地想參與建造過程。他們請來託莉和肯為他們設計和建造，除了有布莉安娜最想做的植物牆，還有一組非常特別的衣櫃，把兩人的衣服全都收納起來。由於這對小夫妻想大量運用天然素材，就連浴室地板都鋪了非常特別的巖板磁磚呢。

programme.title: 義式烹飪大賽第2季:第2集
programme.desc: 在本集節目中，參賽者來到古老的城鎮雷契向義大利祖母們學習製作傳統的義大利麵。

programme.title: 克莉絲汀娜鄉村家第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 本集節目中，特麗絲和湯姆全家從加州搬到田納西州。擅長料理和烘焙的特麗絲不只希望擁有明亮且動線順暢的夢幻廚房，還希望加入能讓她憶起母親的復古元素。

programme.title: 戰痘醫師第4季:第3集
programme.desc: 瑪格麗塔的右手腋下有個像芒果一樣大的脂肪瘤，每次出門，甚至是在子女面前，她都只能穿寬鬆的衣服遮掩。

programme.title: 亞洲好住家第8季:第13集
programme.desc: 五年前到柬埔寨旅行後，瓊安一心想回到柬埔寨盡一份心力，因此她決定放棄在加州的高薪工作，搬到柬埔寨擔任語言治療師。

programme.title: 亞洲好住家第9季:第1集
programme.desc: 在西班牙住了三年的情侶打算搬到越南展開新冒險，兩人對於房子的地點持有不同意見。究竟他們最後會選擇便利的市中心，還是鄰近海邊的房子呢？

programme.title: 超級大體型第2季:第7集
programme.desc: 在減肥外科普羅克特醫生的協助下，病態性肥胖患者為自己的生命奮戰。家庭關係、友誼都備受考驗，唯有少數人會做出真正的改變，進行減重手術來開啟新的人生道路。

programme.desc: 為什麼狗狗老是愛對人類舔來舔去呢？背後有什麼涵義？非洲荒野的大象為什麼會知道沙漠的另一端正在下雨？

programme.title: 動物奇門功夫第1季:第34集
programme.desc: 外型搶眼的紅鸛剛出生時全身都是白色的，過了一陣子竟然還會變成灰色？牠們又是怎麼變成粉紅色，且看節目解密。

programme.title: 動物百分百第3季:第5集
programme.desc: 猿類與人類的基因相似，但也面臨滅絕的危機，透過保育計畫，希望所有的猿類都能繼續成為地球的「森林之人」。

programme.title: 布朗克斯動物園第3季:第13集
programme.desc: 研究生多莉為碩士論文設計了益智箱，找動物園進行研究，評量獅子和雪豹的認知能力。

programme.title: 超能動物第2季:第8集
programme.desc: 自然界的動物可說是無奇不有，有些動物光是外觀就長得很奇怪，有些則是有奇怪的超能力，還有些動物甚至怪得很特別。

programme.title: 超能動物第2季:第7集
programme.desc: 一起認識千里跋涉的遷徙高手，首先是帝王蝶，牠們的遷徙是家族活動，需要好幾個世代接力完成。

programme.title: 百變爬蟲箱第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 赫斯勒家請康乃爾世界替養了五個月的寵物髭頰蜥-奈許，依據電影大娛樂家的概念，打造一個馬戲團缸。同時還替奈許添了一個髭頰蜥同伴-威斯特。葛雷格想替即將小學畢業的女兒愛瑪舉辦驚喜派對，還請了店裡的爬蟲專家小傑，帶牠珍藏的爬蟲來介紹給愛瑪與愛瑪的朋友。

programme.desc: 為什麼狗狗老是愛對人類舔來舔去呢？背後有什麼涵義？非洲荒野的大象為什麼會知道沙漠的另一端正在下雨？

programme.title: 動物奇門功夫第1季:第34集
programme.desc: 外型搶眼的紅鸛剛出生時全身都是白色的，過了一陣子竟然還會變成灰色？牠們又是怎麼變成粉紅色，且看節目解密。

programme.title: 布朗克斯動物園第3季:第13集
programme.desc: 研究生多莉為碩士論文設計了益智箱，找動物園進行研究，評量獅子和雪豹的認知能力。

programme.title: 野地刺客第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 莽原涵蓋了地球20%的陸地面積，住著數以百萬計的生物，牠們全都扮演不可或缺的角色。

programme.title: 河中巨怪-謎樣水域第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 傳說在北歐的冰冷湖泊中，潛藏一種淡水猛獸，牠比任何民間捕魚傳說更深植人心，這隻兇猛無比的掠食者，就是白斑狗魚。

programme.title: 動物百分百第3季:第5集
programme.desc: 猿類與人類的基因相似，但也面臨滅絕的危機，透過保育計畫，希望所有的猿類都能繼續成為地球的「森林之人」。

programme.title: 百變爬蟲箱第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 赫斯勒家請康乃爾世界替養了五個月的寵物髭頰蜥-奈許，依據電影大娛樂家的概念，打造一個馬戲團缸。同時還替奈許添了一個髭頰蜥同伴-威斯特。葛雷格想替即將小學畢業的女兒愛瑪舉辦驚喜派對，還請了店裡的爬蟲專家小傑，帶牠珍藏的爬蟲來介紹給愛瑪與愛瑪的朋友。

programme.title: 布朗克斯動物園第3季:第14集
programme.desc: 在這集的布朗克斯動物園裡，一開始要介紹一隻紅領狐猴伊瑞，牠因樹枝穿刺而受傷，第一次治療時因為疏失而沒找到真正原因，但確認病因治療後，牠也逐漸康復；接著要介紹的是鬃貓，園內幫一對鬃貓配對，但得先幫牠們製作展區，展區製作完後牠們就可登場；另外還介紹了一些亞洲閉殼龜，希望藉此喚醒人們對烏龜的保育意識。

programme.title: 野地刺客第2季:第2集
programme.desc: 溫帶森林涵蓋了地球25%到30%的陸地面積，但這個生物羣落正不斷弱化。

programme.title: 動物奇門功夫第1季:第35集
programme.desc: 狗狗大大的雙眼令人難以抗拒，但科學家發現狗狗竟然只會對人類露出這種表情。奇妙的鴨嘴獸是一種神奇的物種，而且竟然曾和恐龍同時生存在地球上！

programme.title: 動物奇門功夫第1季:第36集
programme.desc: 犀牛這種孤獨的動物竟然會在同一個位置便便。而泰國紅樹林裡則是住著神奇的射水魚，牠可以把水當作武器發射水砲，把樹上的蟲子打下來。

programme.title: 河中巨怪-謎樣水域第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 傳說在北歐的冰冷湖泊中，潛藏一種淡水猛獸，牠比任何民間捕魚傳說更深植人心，這隻兇猛無比的掠食者，就是白斑狗魚。

programme.title: 百變爬蟲箱第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 樂港漫畫書店除了賣漫畫書，也開課教小孩畫漫畫。他們想要一個以電影阿比阿弟的冒險為主題的爬蟲缸，可以放在書店的全齡讀物區，也可以推至教室裡上課用。康乃爾世界仿電影中的時光機，打造出一個電話亭缸，開啟所羅門石龍子的漫畫書店冒險。阿傑爬蟲營的常客瓊丹終於要有第一支爬蟲寵物—摩洛哥刺尾鬣蜥索爾。康乃爾世界依據瓊丹喜愛的鐵人三項運動，打造出奪牌領獎臺造型，兼具現代藝術感的爬蟲箱，完美融入深具現代藝術感的瓊丹家。

programme.title: 獵殺倒數第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 北美洲的惡劣天氣，加上無情的地貌，即使是最強大的動物，也為了適應環境被逼迫到極限。

programme.title: 滅絕動物大追蹤第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 野生生物學家佛瑞斯特葛蘭特將前往哥倫比亞維拉葛雷迪的偏僻村子，尋找80年代後就沒有人看過的阿帕波里斯凱門鱷。

programme.title: 神祕動物大追蹤第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 本集節目中，野生生物學家佛瑞斯特葛蘭特要去尋找傳說中的湖怪。多年來，美國西北沿岸地區的水域一直有水怪的目擊報告，連位於高山的奇藍湖也不例外。佛瑞斯特要去尋找原因，並希望能揭開湖怪的真面目，他能順利達成任務嗎？

programme.title: 熊貓總動員第1季:第1集

programme.title: 野地刺客第2季:第3集

programme.desc: 許多狗主人都堅信可以看出自家狗狗有沒有搗蛋，但狗狗真的會感到內疚嗎？在一片翠綠的森林中，一身亮橘色毛皮的老虎看起來很顯眼，這樣不會妨礙牠們偷襲獵物嗎？

programme.title: 動物奇門功夫第1季:第38集
programme.desc: 現在有越來越多的狗狗，看電視的時間竟然比主人還要長，但牠們看到的究竟是什麼景象呢？烏賊是海裡的偽裝大師，牠們又是怎麼辦到的？

programme.title: 滅絕動物大追蹤第2季:第4集

programme.title: 百變爬蟲箱第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 艾倫和凱倫很久沒養爬蟲了，於是在新家安頓好之後，他們請葛雷格為他們介紹幾隻適合他們，希望是能跟即將出生的女生一起長大、可以把玩的蜥蜴。葛雷格介紹了飾紋刺尾蜥給他們。爬蟲箱的主題則是跟嬰兒房一樣的恐龍荒原主題，陸生缸裡放有符合當地史前時代的恐龍骨頭。

programme.title: 核災過後車諾比
programme.desc: 人類學家瑪莉安歐哈塔和生物學家羅伯尼爾森取得特殊許可，在車諾比核災發生30年後重回禁區，一探輻射汙染對當地生物的影響。他們發現當地的輻射汙染在多年後依然相當嚴重，如果待太久會有致命之虞，不過大自然逐漸復甦，雖然輻射對某些生物造成嚴重的傷害，導致突變，影響繁殖能力，可是生物也演化出適應環境的能力。
